evaluationRules.failOnUncertainty: If an assertion cannot be positively verified from the running app, mark it FAILED. Absence of evidence is a failure.
evaluationRules.credentials: The app must load and be browsable without any .env, private keys or funded account.
evaluationRules.walletGatedFlows: Without a Test Signer, walletRequired assertions stay affordance-only: verify the control is visible and the app explains a wallet is needed.
evaluationRules.evidence: Every issue cites route, element and console output.

assertions.statement: The home route renders the Proof Wall without a wallet, without a .env file and without browser console errors.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to /. Confirm the "Proof Wall" heading is visible together with either the "Connect your wallet to post" message (a topic is configured) or the "Set NEXT_PUBLIC_PROOF_WALL_TOPIC_ID or create a topic in the Admin page." notice (no topic configured, the expected state without a .env), no crash banner is shown and the console has no errors.

assertions.statement: The admin route shows the topic and badge creation controls and explains that a connected wallet is required, without crashing.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to /admin without connecting. Confirm the "Connect a Hedera wallet to create topics and tokens." message, the create-topic and create-token controls (disabled), and no error boundary.

assertions.journey: Create a topic with the test signer
assertions.statement: With the harness test signer stored in localStorage, the app connects on reload without a wallet modal, creates an HCS topic from /admin and the topic exists on the testnet Mirror Node.
assertions.howToVerify: Store the test signer key under localStorage["burnerWallet.pk"] and reload /admin. Do not open any wallet modal: the header must show the signer's 0.0.x account id with a "test signer" badge and the page the "Wallet connected as 0.0.x." message (allow ~20 s for the account to resolve from the Mirror Node). Click "Create topic" and wait for "Topic created" with a 0.0.x topic id. Then GET https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com/api/v1/topics/{topicId} (poll up to 30 s) and confirm memo "Proof Wall" and deleted=false.

assertions.journey: Read Mirror Node data without a wallet
assertions.statement: The explorer route reads topic messages and schedule state straight from the testnet Mirror Node, without a wallet, a .env file or console errors.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to /explorer without connecting. Confirm the "Mirror Explorer" heading and the two cards "Topic messages" and "Schedule state". Type 0.0.10650370 in the topic id field: within a few seconds a list of messages (or "No messages on this topic yet.") replaces the spinner. Type 0.0.10590552 in the schedule id field: a status badge reading "executed" appears with a signature count. Console has no errors.
